race.comment: ZOUTRAIL (12) is desperate to break through and was unlucky not to do so last start when only bursting through late. Gets it light again with the 3kg claimer and with even luck this time she can salute. UPTOWN MONK (8) is drawn to get a suck run if he steps cleanly. Form around him in his debut prep stacks right up and he rates an obvious threat. LEADING IMPACT (5) improved sharply in his second run for the stable when leading pillar-to-post. Is open to further improvement and should give another bold sight. SASSY LITTLE MISS (7) is sill lightly raced and figuring it all out. Was a good winner here two week ago when closing off strongly. Concedes weight to a couple of these but is still improving. NOSTRYIA (9) was well below his best last start but his two runs prior stack up. Not forgetting.
